findings.what: Passing `body_rows - 1` shrinks the page budget by one row, so a backward page covers fewer lines than the old loop whenever lines fit exactly into `body_rows`. The old loop accepted `used + row <= body_rows`. This brings back the direction-mismatched page size the doc comment warns about.

When `body_rows` is 0, `body_rows - 1` underflows. That panics in debug builds and wraps to `usize::MAX` in release, which pages all the way back to line 0. The old loop handled 0 rows safely and returned 1.
